event_name: Aston Martin Red Bull Racing Document 42 Date 26 May 2019 Time 17:27 2019 MONACO GRAND PRIX 22 - 26 May 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Involved in an alleged Incident as defined by Article 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Car 33 attempted to pass car 44 on the inside at turn 10 and contact resulted. The Stewards considered that neither car was wholly or predominantly at fault for the collision and both drivers took appropriate action subsequently to mitigate the effects of the contact. The Stewards therefore take no further action.
rules_referenced: Article 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 33 Incident With Car 44 In Turn 10
